meta.title: Battle Dialogue · A Flash of Thunder
meta.description: In that moment, in all directions, light and dark split.

units.rawText: We've reached the ambush point! Caina is still distracted by the explosions, is everyone ready?
units.displayText: We've reached the ambush point! Caina is still distracted by the explosions, is everyone ready?

spans.text: We've reached the ambush point! Caina is still distracted by the explosions, is everyone ready?

units.rawText: Yep. I've started up the Spoof Code again. Once Caina enters the kill box, you and I will pincer her from front and back while Alcyone charges up a shot to finish her off.
units.displayText: Yep. I've started up the Spoof Code again. Once Caina enters the kill box, you and I will pincer her from front and back while Alcyone charges up a shot to finish her off.

spans.text: Yep. I've started up the Spoof Code again. Once Caina enters the kill box, you and I will pincer her from front and back while Alcyone charges up a shot to finish her off.

units.rawText: Just as he finishes speaking, Caina calmly strolls into the area. The strange way she's walking makes my neural cloud systems freeze up briefly.
units.displayText: Just as he finishes speaking, Caina calmly strolls into the area. The strange way she's walking makes my neural cloud systems freeze up briefly.

spans.text: Just as he finishes speaking, Caina calmly strolls into the area. The strange way she's walking makes my neural cloud systems freeze up briefly.

units.rawText: Ah-ah... Honestly, it's been so boring all this while...
units.displayText: Ah-ah... Honestly, it's been so boring all this while...

spans.text: Ah-ah... Honestly, it's been so boring all this while...

units.rawText: Those guys were too weak and kept dying whenever I did anything to them. Even squishing them to bits wasn't fun...
units.displayText: Those guys were too weak and kept dying whenever I did anything to them. Even squishing them to bits wasn't fun...

spans.text: Those guys were too weak and kept dying whenever I did anything to them. Even squishing them to bits wasn't fun...

units.rawText: (What's she complaining about?)
units.displayText: What's she complaining about?

spans.text: What's she complaining about?

units.rawText: (Beats me. There's no telling what a lunatic like her is thinking, and she's an Entropic, too.)
units.displayText: Beats me. There's no telling what a lunatic like her is thinking, and she's an Entropic, too.

spans.text: Beats me. There's no telling what a lunatic like her is thinking, and she's an Entropic, too.

units.rawText: (Be careful. Something's not right. She's almost in the kill box.)
units.displayText: Be careful. Something's not right. She's almost in the kill box.

spans.text: Be careful. Something's not right. She's almost in the kill box.

units.rawText: But not today! So many interesting opponents showed up at once!
units.displayText: But not today! So many interesting opponents showed up at once!

spans.text: But not today! So many interesting opponents showed up at once!

units.rawText: At last! At long last! I finally get a good fight!
units.displayText: At last! At long last! I finally get a good fight!

spans.text: At last! At long last! I finally get a good fight!

units.rawText: Caina's voice grows louder and louder, as though she's speaking to herself, or perhaps she already knows we're there and she's saying all of that for our benefit.
units.displayText: Caina's voice grows louder and louder, as though she's speaking to herself, or perhaps she already knows we're there and she's saying all of that for our benefit.

spans.text: Caina's voice grows louder and louder, as though she's speaking to herself, or perhaps she already knows we're there and she's saying all of that for our benefit.

units.rawText: Right after that, her voice suddenly levels off.
units.displayText: Right after that, her voice suddenly levels off.

spans.text: Right after that, her voice suddenly levels off.

units.rawText: But why are you doing this? Why are you trying to ambush me? I mean, I already consider you worthy opponents.
units.displayText: But why are you doing this? Why are you trying to ambush me? I mean, I already consider you worthy opponents.

spans.text: But why are you doing this? Why are you trying to ambush me? I mean, I already consider you worthy opponents.

units.rawText: I know ambushes are wrong. Ptolemaea's to blame for those previous ambushes. She insisted that I do it, so what choice did I have? Lady Malkira always listens to her.
units.displayText: I know ambushes are wrong. Ptolemaea's to blame for those previous ambushes. She insisted that I do it, so what choice did I have? Lady Malkira always listens to her.

spans.text: I know ambushes are wrong. Ptolemaea's to blame for those previous ambushes. She insisted that I do it, so what choice did I have? Lady Malkira always listens to her.

units.rawText: So maybe I was wrong, but you guys took revenge on me too, right? Aren't we even now? I mean, whose fault was it for not wanting to fight with me anyway? But then you kept trying to get back at me, over and over again!
units.displayText: So maybe I was wrong, but you guys took revenge on me too, right? Aren't we even now? I mean, whose fault was it for not wanting to fight with me anyway? But then you kept trying to get back at me, over and over again!

spans.text: So maybe I was wrong, but you guys took revenge on me too, right? Aren't we even now? I mean, whose fault was it for not wanting to fight with me anyway? But then you kept trying to get back at me, over and over again!

units.rawText: Caina raises her head and looks around. Finally, her eyes settle on where Alcyone is.
units.displayText: Caina raises her head and looks around. Finally, her eyes settle on where Alcyone is.

spans.text: Caina raises her head and looks around. Finally, her eyes settle on where Alcyone is.

units.rawText: Atlas surreptitiously changes direction and unease wells up in my heart.
units.displayText: Atlas surreptitiously changes direction and unease wells up in my heart.

spans.text: Atlas surreptitiously changes direction and unease wells up in my heart.

units.rawText: But that's okay, I don't mind! Ptolemaea told me how to get you guys to fight me, yes she did.
units.displayText: But that's okay, I don't mind! Ptolemaea told me how to get you guys to fight me, yes she did.

spans.text: But that's okay, I don't mind! Ptolemaea told me how to get you guys to fight me, yes she did.

units.rawText: The corner of Caina's mouth turns up and her mouth opens to expose her tongue as her placid face suddenly distorts.
units.displayText: The corner of Caina's mouth turns up and her mouth opens to expose her tongue as her placid face suddenly distorts.

spans.text: The corner of Caina's mouth turns up and her mouth opens to expose her tongue as her placid face suddenly distorts.

units.rawText: She said that if I crippled the one with the bow, you'd fight me for sure, the way I wanted.
units.displayText: She said that if I crippled the one with the bow, you'd fight me for sure, the way I wanted.

spans.text: She said that if I crippled the one with the bow, you'd fight me for sure, the way I wanted.

units.rawText: A good! Proper! <size=40>FIGHT!</size>
units.displayText: A good! Proper! FIGHT!

spans.text: A good! Proper!
FIGHT!

units.rawText: Crap! Our cover's blown!
units.displayText: Crap! Our cover's blown!

spans.text: Crap! Our cover's blown!

units.rawText: Before I can finish, Caina is a streak of red light rushing toward Alcyone and Electra's hiding place.
units.displayText: Before I can finish, Caina is a streak of red light rushing toward Alcyone and Electra's hiding place.

spans.text: Before I can finish, Caina is a streak of red light rushing toward Alcyone and Electra's hiding place.

units.rawText: <size=40>ALCYONE!!</size>
units.displayText: ALCYONE!!

spans.text: ALCYONE!!

units.rawText: Atlas dashes forth like a loosed arrow. His greatsword is like the arrow's point, igniting as it cleaves through the air.
units.displayText: Atlas dashes forth like a loosed arrow. His greatsword is like the arrow's point, igniting as it cleaves through the air.

spans.text: Atlas dashes forth like a loosed arrow. His greatsword is like the arrow's point, igniting as it cleaves through the air.

units.rawText: Shing—Crash!
units.displayText: Shing—Crash!

spans.text: Shing—Crash!

units.rawText: Alcyone's cover cracks, and her disguise breaks down. Alcyone falls flat on her butt, her eyes filled with fear and confusion.
units.displayText: Alcyone's cover cracks, and her disguise breaks down. Alcyone falls flat on her butt, her eyes filled with fear and confusion.

spans.text: Alcyone's cover cracks, and her disguise breaks down. Alcyone falls flat on her butt, her eyes filled with fear and confusion.

units.rawText: But how...
units.displayText: But how...

spans.text: But how...

units.rawText: She is answered by Caina, in a voice that's practically a shriek.
units.displayText: She is answered by Caina, in a voice that's practically a shriek.

spans.text: She is answered by Caina, in a voice that's practically a shriek.

units.rawText: There is no splash of operands, no screaming, only the sound of metal clashing with metal.
units.displayText: There is no splash of operands, no screaming, only the sound of metal clashing with metal.

spans.text: There is no splash of operands, no screaming, only the sound of metal clashing with metal.

units.rawText: Her blade's tip strikes home and the vicious flame penetrates Atlas' defense, burning away all our preparations.
units.displayText: Her blade's tip strikes home and the vicious flame penetrates Atlas' defense, burning away all our preparations.

spans.text: Her blade's tip strikes home and the vicious flame penetrates Atlas' defense, burning away all our preparations.

units.rawText: Atlas' greatsword and chest are split in half and his towering figure wobbles.
units.displayText: Atlas' greatsword and chest are split in half and his towering figure wobbles.

spans.text: Atlas' greatsword and chest are split in half and his towering figure wobbles.

units.rawText: Urgh...
units.displayText: Urgh...

spans.text: Urgh...

units.rawText: HAHAHAHA! What's wrong? Weren't you supposed to be pretty strong? Why are you so damn weak?
units.displayText: HAHAHAHA! What's wrong? Weren't you supposed to be pretty strong? Why are you so damn weak?

spans.text: HAHAHAHA! What's wrong? Weren't you supposed to be pretty strong? Why are you so damn weak?

units.rawText: Atlas' wounding was so sudden that several seconds pass in silence before Alcyone came to her senses.
units.displayText: Atlas' wounding was so sudden that several seconds pass in silence before Alcyone came to her senses.

spans.text: Atlas' wounding was so sudden that several seconds pass in silence before Alcyone came to her senses.

units.rawText: <size=40>NO!!! ATLAS!!!</size>
units.displayText: NO!!! ATLAS!!!

spans.text: NO!!! ATLAS!!!

units.rawText: How... How could this... Atlas' defense was... How could you get through it so easily?
units.displayText: How... How could this... Atlas' defense was... How could you get through it so easily?

spans.text: How... How could this... Atlas' defense was... How could you get through it so easily?

units.rawText: It can't be, right? Why? No... Atlas, no...
units.displayText: It can't be, right? Why? No... Atlas, no...

spans.text: It can't be, right? Why? No... Atlas, no...

units.rawText: Urk—Hrghh—
units.displayText: Urk—Hrghh—

spans.text: Urk—Hrghh—

units.rawText: Atlas stumbles back. His vocalization systems are severed and cannot establish a connection, while his neural cloud systems flicker in and out of functionality.
units.displayText: Atlas stumbles back. His vocalization systems are severed and cannot establish a connection, while his neural cloud systems flicker in and out of functionality.

spans.text: Atlas stumbles back. His vocalization systems are severed and cannot establish a connection, while his neural cloud systems flicker in and out of functionality.

units.rawText: As I watch in a daze, information from the past flashes through my visual systems.
units.displayText: As I watch in a daze, information from the past flashes through my visual systems.

spans.text: As I watch in a daze, information from the past flashes through my visual systems.

units.rawText: Atlas? That wound on your side...
units.displayText: Atlas? That wound on your side...

spans.text: Atlas? That wound on your side...

units.rawText: Oh, this? Haha, looks like that explosion was a bit more powerful than I expected. The force field I threw up earlier couldn't stop all of it.
units.displayText: Oh, this? Haha, looks like that explosion was a bit more powerful than I expected. The force field I threw up earlier couldn't stop all of it.

spans.text: Oh, this? Haha, looks like that explosion was a bit more powerful than I expected. The force field I threw up earlier couldn't stop all of it.

units.rawText: Man, just bringing up a basic mistake like this is making me all embarrassed. It's nothing; I can heal it up once we enter the Middle Ring. We've got more important things to do right now.
units.displayText: Man, just bringing up a basic mistake like this is making me all embarrassed. It's nothing; I can heal it up once we enter the Middle Ring. We've got more important things to do right now.

spans.text: Man, just bringing up a basic mistake like this is making me all embarrassed. It's nothing; I can heal it up once we enter the Middle Ring. We've got more important things to do right now.

units.rawText: Give me a bit of time. We need to consider how the Spoof Code lost its effectiveness, as well as the strength of the Entropics. After all, the strength of the Entropics we encountered just now is on a whole new level from when we just entered the Outer Ring.
units.displayText: Give me a bit of time. We need to consider how the Spoof Code lost its effectiveness, as well as the strength of the Entropics. After all, the strength of the Entropics we encountered just now is on a whole new level from when we just entered the Outer Ring.

spans.text: Give me a bit of time. We need to consider how the Spoof Code lost its effectiveness, as well as the strength of the Entropics. After all, the strength of the Entropics we encountered just now is on a whole new level from when we just entered the Outer Ring.

units.rawText: The data doesn't lie, I was monitoring our operand expenditures, and killing these Low Order Entropics is burning through operands at twice the usual rate.
units.displayText: The data doesn't lie, I was monitoring our operand expenditures, and killing these Low Order Entropics is burning through operands at twice the usual rate.

spans.text: The data doesn't lie, I was monitoring our operand expenditures, and killing these Low Order Entropics is burning through operands at twice the usual rate.

units.rawText: ...I see, So that's what was going on.
units.displayText: ...I see, So that's what was going on.

spans.text: ...I see, So that's what was going on.

units.rawText: The Entropics weren't getting stronger, but we were getting weaker, is that it?
units.displayText: The Entropics weren't getting stronger, but we were getting weaker, is that it?

spans.text: The Entropics weren't getting stronger, but we were getting weaker, is that it?

units.rawText: But why... Dammit... This isn't the time... to be figuring this out...
units.displayText: But why... Dammit... This isn't the time... to be figuring this out...

spans.text: But why... Dammit... This isn't the time... to be figuring this out...

units.rawText: Warning—Warning—Insufficient system redundancy. Systems operating beyond capacity. Warning.
units.displayText: Warning—Warning—Insufficient system redundancy. Systems operating beyond capacity. Warning.

spans.text: Warning—Warning—Insufficient system redundancy. Systems operating beyond capacity. Warning.

units.rawText: Lame lame lame lame lame, why are you all so damn weak?
units.displayText: Lame lame lame lame lame, why are you all so damn weak?

spans.text: Lame lame lame lame lame, why are you all so damn weak?

units.rawText: You call this a fight? To think I got my hopes up.
units.displayText: You call this a fight? To think I got my hopes up.

spans.text: You call this a fight? To think I got my hopes up.

units.rawText: Caina grumbles to herself as she shoves Atlas aside to deal with Alcyone.
units.displayText: Caina grumbles to herself as she shoves Atlas aside to deal with Alcyone.

spans.text: Caina grumbles to herself as she shoves Atlas aside to deal with Alcyone.

units.rawText: Don't... touch... her...
units.displayText: Don't... touch... her...

spans.text: Don't... touch... her...

units.rawText: Hm?
units.displayText: Hm?

spans.text: Hm?

units.rawText: <size=60><color=red>DON'T YOU TOUCH HER!</color></size>
units.displayText: DON'T YOU TOUCH HER!

spans.text: DON'T YOU TOUCH HER!
